title: 주말 활동: 산책, 청소, 쇼핑
objective: By the end, you can name common weekend activities in Korean and use them in short sentences, such as 산책해요, 청소해요, and 영화를 봐요.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about what you do on the weekend.

task.title: Use weekend activity words
task.line: Read each situation, then choose or write the word from this worksheet that fits best.

words.exampleMeaning: What are you doing this weekend?

words.meaning: a walk (for fun); 산책하다 = to take a walk
words.exampleMeaning: I take a walk in the park with my dog.

words.meaning: cleaning (a room or house); 청소하다 = to clean

words.exampleMeaning: I go shopping in Myeongdong with my older sister.
I watch a movie on Saturday evening.
A friend is coming to my house tomorrow.

words.meaning: laundry; 빨래를 하다 = to do the laundry
words.exampleMeaning: I do the laundry on Sunday morning.

words.meaning: exercise; 운동하다 = to work out, to exercise
to rest, to relax (쉬어요 = I rest)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm tired, so I'm relaxing at home.

exercises: Choose the right word: 옷이 없어요. 백화점에서 (쇼핑 / 산책)해요.
Fill in the blank: 토요일하고 일요일은 ____이에요.
Choose the right word: 피곤해요. 오늘은 집에서 (쉬어요 / 운동해요).
Fill in each blank with a word from this worksheet's word list: ① 배가 고파요. 집에서 ____해요. ② 강아지하고 걸어요. 공원에서 ____해요. ③ 옷이 더러워요(dirty). ____를 해요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean. 미나: 준 씨, 주말에 뭐 해요? / 준: 토요일에 친구하고 영화를 봐요. 일요일에는 집을 청소해요. ① 준 씨는 토요일에 누구하고 영화를 봐요? ② 준 씨는 토요일에 뭐 해요? ③ 준 씨는 일요일에 뭐 해요?
answers: ① 요리 ② 산책 ③ 빨래
① 친구 (친구하고 봐요) ② 영화를 봐요 ③ 청소해요 (집을 청소해요)
